powers.name: Super Speed
powers.description: Burst into open grass with or without the ball.

powers.name: Blink Run
powers.description: Blink beyond the last defender and pull the ball through the gap.

powers.name: Thunder Strike
powers.description: Charge the next clean shot with enough force to batter keeper Resolve.

powers.name: Fire Torch
powers.description: Burn past one, two, or three nearby goal-side defenders as the power is upgraded.

powers.name: Phase Run
powers.description: Ghost through the next tackle, but wait to become solid before shooting.

powers.name: Portal Pass
powers.description: Drop the ball through a portal onto the best forward runner, protected until they pass, shoot, or the shield fades.

powers.name: Decoy Double
powers.description: Create an extra hologram forward that can carry, pass, and shoot until it pops.

powers.name: Future Sight
powers.description: Read the next pass, steal it, then guarantee an outlet to the furthest-forward onside teammate.

powers.name: Super Strength
powers.description: Freeze a dangerous carrier for a half-second charge, then flatten them and win the ball.

powers.name: Web Trap
powers.description: Drop the carrier's ball and web them in place while everyone else can recover it.

powers.name: Elastic Keeper
powers.description: Stretch across the whole goal against the next dangerous shot.

powers.name: Rally Cry
powers.description: Grant one nearby hero an Encore: exactly one extra power activation this match.

powers.name: Ice Rink
powers.description: Freeze the carrier and ball into a backward slide toward their own goal.

powers.name: Shadow Mark
powers.description: Burrow for two seconds, hunt the area for ten, then erupt for a guaranteed steal.

powers.name: Gravity Well
powers.description: Pull one or two defenders away, send a runner into the abandoned lane, and feed them next.

powers.name: Giant GK
powers.description: Swell to fill the goalmouth for the whole attack.

powers.name: Gust
powers.description: Bend the opponent's next good pass safely to your keeper, who punts into attack.
